title: TSM Cross-Domain Cascade: Governed Compounding-Risk Intelligence
_note: Scripted scenario: source relays are seeded and engine outputs canned via tests/e2e/helpers/stub-war-room.js, not live model output. Captions are DRAFTS. Narration lines are DRAFTS too: spoken text for --narrate, numbers written as words.

states.caption: Supplier and Plant relays loaded into the cascade
states.narration: Two war rooms have already reported: a supplier shutdown, and a plant incident. The Cross-Domain Cascade room loads both, and asks what they mean together. What follows is a simulated incident.

states.caption: Six engines complete: risk scored 79/100
states.narration: Six engines read across both cases. A supplier failure on turbine housings meets reduced capacity on Line Three, and the combined buffer is under nine days. Exposure runs from one point four to two point six million dollars. The risk score is seventy-nine out of one hundred.

states.caption: Operations Strategist receives the cascade relay
states.narration: The Operations Strategist receives the cascade alongside the supplier and plant cases behind it.

states.caption: Executive Portal with the cascade relay
states.narration: The Executive Portal shows the decision that protects the line: qualify an alternate castings supplier within three days, for ninety thousand dollars. The system recommends. A person decides.
